svg.text: Nimbus · AWS architecture with automatic scaling
Stage 3 deployment in the AWS Academy Sandbox (us-east-1), created by one CloudFormation template
A new GitCommit replaces the servers one by one; RDS stays.
route: local only · no internet, no NAT
min 1 · max 3 · adds / removes servers on the alarms · replaces unhealthy ones
every server is built the same
way: EC2 user data installs the
setup, or only when scaled out
Status: VPC, EC2 and RDS verified on AWS 25–29 Oct 2026 · load balancer, automatic scale-out / scale-in and self-healing verified 31 Oct 2026
No NAT gateway: the database needs no internet access. App servers have no IAM role. Passwords are CloudFormation NoEcho parameters, never in the repository.
